{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Neutralize an object by intrinsic means:
* soldiers are blown up by mine
*  vehicles are shelled by artillery
*  air units are hit by AA missile
*  underwater units are simply killed.

{{Feature|informative|[[allowDamage]] will '''not''' prevent the unit getting killed.}}

|r1= [[Boolean]]
